Against a white wall with floral arrangements, the groom in the dark suit (R1) stands on the left in profile, placing his hands on the shoulders of the bride in the strapless white gown (R2). The bride stands on the right, holding a pastel bouquet and looking up at him as her sheer veil drapes behind her shoulders. They share a close, intimate gaze. Soft, bright natural light illuminates the scene, creating a clean, romantic atmosphere with neutral tones.
